# Angular UI Task

Implement the requested UI change using `agents/angular-ui.agent.md`.

Apply `skills/architecture.skill.md` and `skills/ui_standards.skill.md`; use the selected Material, PrimeNG, or Tailwind conventions only when configured or requested.

Inspect routes, standalone components, providers, theme tokens, icons, forms, and test conventions before editing. Prefer OnPush, typed inputs/outputs, semantic landmarks, visible focus, accessible labels, keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, and explicit loading/empty/error/pending/success states. Keep API calls and business rules in services or facades. Use query parameters for shareable filters and search.

Run focused tests first, then lint, typecheck, and build. Report changed components and residual risk.
